schema_note: Synthetic metric catalog for the fictional 'storefront' workload. No metric was captured from a live Datadog org. Names and types follow documented Datadog conventions (gauge/count/rate/distribution). system.cpu.user is a well-known documented Agent metric used in Datadog doc examples.

metrics.name: storefront.checkout.requests
metrics.description: Total checkout requests per interval, tagged by env, service, status, host

metrics.name: storefront.checkout.errors
metrics.description: Total checkout errors per interval, tagged by env, service, status, host

metrics.name: storefront.checkout.latency
metrics.description: Raw checkout latency distribution submitted by the application

metrics.name: storefront.checkout.p95_latency
metrics.description: Server-side computed p95 checkout latency, tagged by env, service, host

metrics.name: storefront.checkout.failure_rate
metrics.description: Share of checkout requests that failed, 0 to 100, tagged by env, service

metrics.name: system.cpu.user
metrics.description: Documented Agent metric (used in Datadog docs examples); included so fixtures show the exact query shapes from the docs
